text.autoconfig.autoharvest.option.autoS: Automatically switches to a Fortune-enchanted tool in your hotbar when in Harvest mode or Farmer mode.
text.autoconfig.autoharvest.option.coolD: Cooldown between interactions with feedable entities in Feed mode, in §aseconds§r.
text.autoconfig.autoharvest.option.enabl: When enabled, automatically refills the item required for the current mode into your hand, also applies to Farmer mode (requires holding the item).
text.autoconfig.autoharvest.option.fishi: Stops fishing when the fishing rod's remaining uses drop below this value.
Automatically stops fishing when the fishing rod's durability is too low.
text.autoconfig.autoharvest.option.radiu: Custom-mode scan radius in tenths of a block (10–65). Example: 45 = 4.5 blocks. Retained but ignored in player-attribute mode.
text.autoconfig.autoharvest.option.remem: When AutoHarvest is toggled on, it restores the last used mode automatically.
text.autoconfig.autoharvest.option.thecu: The current mode. Changes take effect after re-toggling the mod.
text.autoconfig.autoharvest.title: AutoHarvest Configuration
text.autoconfig.autoharvest.option.bambo: The spacing between two bamboo plants when planting in Plant Mode. [§cOnly enforces spacing; cannot guarantee neat alignment.§f]
text.autoconfig.autoharvest.option.autoS: Auto-switches to the appropriate hotbar item. Does not affect Harvest mode and Fishing mode.
text.autoconfig.autoharvest.option.ticks: Game ticks between active batches. Each batch attempts up to Maximum Actions per Active Tick; one game tick is 1/20 second.
autoharvest.mode.fishing.error: §a[AutoHarvest] §cThe fishing bobber is stuck — please check its position!
text.autoconfig.autoharvest.option.fishi: The interval between retracting the fishing rod and automatically casting it again, in ticks.
text.autoconfig.autoharvest.option.autoS: Automatically switch to the fishing rod in the hotbar when in fishing mode.
text.autoconfig.autoharvest.option.isFlo: Should weed mode skip flowers, leaf litter, flower clusters, crimson fungus and warped fungus?
text.autoconfig.autoharvest.option.autoe: Automatically enable the mode after switching
text.autoconfig.autoharvest.option.skipw: Hoeing mode will not check for nearby water sources
text.autoconfig.autoharvest.option.farme: When enabled, Farmer mode places seeds into the offhand instead of the main hand.
text.autoconfig.autoharvest.option.maxAc: Maximum dispatched world interactions on each action tick (1–64). Failed attempts also count. Farmer planting and harvesting share this budget. Fishing retains its original timing.
text.autoconfig.autoharvest.option.range: Custom: use the existing radius setting. Player attribute: read current block interaction range for blocks and entity interaction range for animals, including attribute modifiers. Server rules still apply.
text.autoconfig.autoharvest.option.swing: Send a normal vanilla hand swing for successful client-side interactions. Uses the actual main/off hand; visible to other players normally. Disabled by default. Server-triggered animations are not suppressed.
